lines.en: I veer around that obsidian pillar.
I fly hugging the pillar's shadow.

lines.zh: 逆着虚空风，我压低身子。
lines.en: Against the void wind I keep low.
The End's wind carries no scent.

lines.zh: 末地的风吹不动我，我慢慢飞。
lines.en: The End wind can't push me; I fly slowly.

lines.zh: 末地里没有云，只有紫雾。
lines.en: The End has no clouds, only violet haze.
That clearing will do for a landing.
Nothing but void below; do not look.
My wingtip grazes the end stone without stopping.

lines.zh: 紫颂果在风里晃了一下。
lines.en: A chorus fruit sways once in the wind.

lines.zh: 末地荒地，我飘着不打翅。
lines.en: Over End wastes I drift without flapping.
The End has no day or night; I know it all.
The End wind lifts me higher.

lines.zh: 再飞高一点，谁也够不到。
lines.en: A little higher, beyond anyone's reach.
I glide along the purple haze.
After long flight, my wing base aches.

lines.zh: 末地的紫颂果，比花更甜。
lines.en: Chorus fruit in the End is sweeter than flowers.

lines.zh: 虚空深处有低低的响声。
lines.en: A low sound rolls deep in the void.
I wait for wind before taking off.
Something is moving below.
Perched too long, my claws go numb.
In the End barrens, even wind stops.
One eye on my wing closes first.

lines.zh: 末地的天空没有夜，只有紫。
lines.en: The End has no night, only purple.
In the End sky, there is only me.

lines.zh: 末地的空里，翅上眼睛最亮。
lines.en: In End air, the eyes on my wings shine.

lines.zh: 数末地的浮岛，一座，两座。
lines.en: Counting End islands, one, two.
I rest on a floating block of stone.

lines.zh: 翅上的眼斑，不是给你看的。
lines.en: The eyespots on my wings aren't for you.

lines.zh: 末地的紫雾，把我的眼斑糊了。
lines.en: The End's violet haze has blurred my eyespots.
An endermite is crawling on your head.

lines.zh: 末地的风里，我翅上的眼不眨。
lines.en: In the End wind, the eye on my wing never blinks.
You crushed a piece of end stone.

lines.zh: 你从传送门那边来的吧。
lines.en: You came through the portal, didn't you?
Your cloak corner flutters in the wind.

lines.zh: 你抬头了，我就在这块荒地上。
lines.en: You looked up, and here I am on the waste.

lines.zh: 我的翅斑正对着你的脸。
lines.en: The eyespots on my wings face your face.
The name's Ender Eyespot Butterfly, remember.
My scales drift loose; it hurts.
Who struck the base of my wing?
That hit landed on a wing vein.
A hole in my wing makes me fly crooked.
The End's wind won't blow me down.
My wing is bent, but I can still glide.
My wing membrane split; wind leaks through.
The violet light makes my ears ring.

lines.zh: 我飞到柱子背面躲一下。
lines.en: I slip behind the pillar to hide.
You shook my scales loose.
Just let me touch the petals.
One drop, just one drop of nectar.
This flower is rare in the End.
I land on your fingertip first.
Your palm sweats; the flower will fall.
The End's scent carries far.
One sweet scent and my wings will not settle.
Keep the flower out; I am coming.

lines.zh: 末地那么空，你带什么进来了？
lines.en: The End is empty; what did you bring?
Is that purple bloom for me?
I skim past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 末地荒地，紫色一飘就过。
lines.en: Over End barrens, a purple drift passes.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的眼斑，先看见你。
lines.en: The eyespots on my wings saw you first.

lines.zh: 在末地上空，我们撞了两次。
lines.en: Above the End, we collided twice.
Excuse me, I am off to pollinate.
This pillar is too wide to get around.
Do not touch my wing edge; it tears.
The End's wind has no brakes.

lines.zh: 翅膀一折，我就飘不动了。
lines.en: One bent wing and I can't drift.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲蹭掉我的鳞粉。
lines.en: Your armor scrapes off my scales.
My nest is tucked in an end stone crack.
The two of us circle the pillar together.
Who are the eyes on my wings for?
You beat once, and I beat once.
I saved you a branch on the chorus tree.
You then, no swapping.
Follow me and do not fall behind.
Wing against wing means yes.
The End's wind carries me in circles.
Show me the eyespots on your wings.

lines.zh: 末地的风把我吹得打转。
lines.en: The End's wind spins me around.
I found this shiny thing.

lines.zh: 我翅上的眼斑像末影眼。
lines.en: The eyespots on my wings look like ender eyes.

lines.zh: 爪尖勾住，才没掉进虚空。
lines.en: My claws caught it before the void took it.

lines.zh: 我把眼斑合起来，装成石头。
lines.en: I fold my eyespots and pass for stone.
I carry this chorus fruit morsel.
I gather a small chorus fruit.
All six legs wrap around it.
I can hold this crumb.
This scale has a fine color.
My eyespots have fixed on your eyes.
You have entered my airspace.

lines.zh: 末地石的影子里，你是黑的。
lines.en: In the end stone's shadow, you stand out black.

lines.zh: 就是现在，翅上的眼睁开。
lines.en: Now — the eye on my wing opens.
One flick of my wings is the signal.

lines.zh: 翅上的眼斑已经对着你。
lines.en: The eyespots on my wings face you.
Your shadow stretches longer than the pillar.
Your neck has no armor.
Nectar is not enough; I need something else.
You smell sweet to me.
My wing membrane blots out the starlight.

lines.zh: 这片荒地没有别的出口。
lines.en: This waste has no other way out.
I fly level with your hat brim.
You go left, my wings go left.

lines.zh: 我翅上的眼一直看着你。
lines.en: The eyes on my wings never leave you.

lines.zh: 这附近没有能藏身的洞。
lines.en: There is no hole to hide in nearby.

lines.zh: 末地的荒地上，紫色眼斑一闪。
lines.en: On the End barrens, my purple eyespots flash.
You have reached the edge of the End.
In the void, I'm faster than you.
Do not look up; my wings will graze you.
Running now is far too late.

lines.zh: 我从末地高地上飘下来了。
lines.en: I drift down from the End highlands.

lines.zh: 翅上的眼斑，先看你一眼。
lines.en: The eyespot on my wing looks at you first.
Scale dust is in your eyes now.
My wings close and you lose sight of me.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在你护目镜上。
lines.en: I ram straight into your goggles.
End eyespots — diving in.

lines.zh: 末地的紫色眼斑，替我盯着。
lines.en: My End-purple eyespots watch for me.
An End eyespot, fixed on you.
My wing edge leaves a white line.
The End air is always cold.
Just emerged; my wings are still soft.

lines.zh: 我从末地石缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of an end stone crack.

lines.zh: 有人在末地石上叫醒我。
lines.en: Someone woke me on the end stone.

lines.zh: 我从虚空边上掉了一下。
lines.en: I slipped at the void's edge.
This patch of sky is mine to fly.
First the eyespots on my wings open.
My wings are dry; I can fly.
Is this the End highlands?
The End's purple glow suits me.
End wings scorched by flame.

lines.zh: 我从末地高地被风打下来。
lines.en: Wind knocked me off the End highlands.
The eyespots on my wings crinkle in water.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪，把我掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast knocked me clean over.
An arrow tore my wing membrane.
One touch of magic and I can't fly.
Two days without a drop of nectar.
The End has no thunder; something is wrong.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我的翅斑还亮着。
lines.en: In the void, my eyespots still shine.
